name: spritecast
description: Game props and characters at their real size and exact camera angle, drawn in your art style - props, standing figures, and 8-direction walking characters (3D-guided).

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Drawing props and characters (about $0.07 a prop, $2.2 a walking character). From platform.openai.com.

tripo_api_key.title: Tripo API key (optional)
tripo_api_key.description: Walking characters and animals: the 3D model and its rig (75 / 30 credits). From platform.tripo3d.ai.

meshy_api_key.title: Meshy API key (optional)
meshy_api_key.description: Only if you choose Meshy as the 3D modeller ("modeler": "meshy").
